name: std::tuple_element<std::tuple>

declarations.code:
template <std::size_t I, class... Types>

struct tuple_element<I, std::tuple<Types...>>;

intro: Provides compile-time indexed access to the types of the elements of the tuple.

sections.title: Member types
sections.text:

 Definition
